identificationModule.briefTitle: The Trial of SHR6508 in Secondary Hyperparathyroidism
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomised, Double-blind, Double-dummy Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of SHR6508 in Hemodialysis Subjects With Secondary Hyperparathyroidism

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is being conducted to evaluate the efficacy and safety of SHR6508 among Chinese patients with secondary hyperparathyroidism of chronic kidney disease treated by maintenance hemodialysis.

armGroups.label: Treatment group
interventionNames: Drug: SHR6508 plus oral placebo tablets

primaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of Participants to End of Study whose iPTH decreased by>30% from baseline
primaryOutcomes.description: iPTH was tested at a central laboratory.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: efficacy assessment period, defined as Week 20-27

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of Participants to End of Study whose iPTH decreased by>50% from baseline
secondaryOutcomes.description: iPTH was tested at a central laboratory.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: efficacy assessment period, defined as Week 20-27

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of nausea and vomiting events
secondaryOutcomes.description: Terms were coded with Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Day1 to End of Treatment, End of Treatment is about Week 27

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of Participants to End of Treatment whose iPTH decreased to 300 pg/mL from baseline
secondaryOutcomes.description: iPTH was tested at a central laboratory.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: efficacy assessment period, defined as Week 20-27

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in serum cCa and P
secondaryOutcomes.description: cCa and P were tested at a central laboratory.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: efficacy assessment period, defined as Week 20-27

secondaryOutcomes.description: Terms were coded with Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Day1 to End of Study, End of Study is about Week 31

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participants with Anti-SHR6508 Antibody at baseline and postbaseline
secondaryOutcomes.description: Anti-SHR6508 Antibody was measured in patient serum samples using a validated enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) method.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Day1 to End of Study, End of Study is about Week 31

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Able and willing to provide a written informed consent
2. Diagnosed with end stage renal disease receiving maintenance hemodialysis
3. Male or female
4. Meet the Body Mass Index standard
5. Stably use of concomitant medication of other therapies of SHPT
6. Meet the standard of iPTH level, cCa

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Subjects with a history of malignant tumor
2. Subjects with neuropsychiatric diseases
3. Subjects with a history of cardiovascular diseases
4. Subjects with gastrointestinal diseases
5. Subjects with a history of surgery
6. Subjects with a history of blood loss
7. Abnormal blood pressure, serum magnesium, serum transaminase, serum albumin
8. Subjects with a treatment history of similar drugs
9. Allergic to a drug ingredient or component
10. Pregnant or nursing women
11. No birth control during the specified period of time
12. Subject with a history of alcohol abuse and drug abuse
13. Participated in clinical trials of other drugs
14. The investigators determined that other conditions were inappropriate for participation in this clinical trial
